create_camera_instance: create a Camera instance with rotation, translation, FoV, and image path for 3D scene rendering
set_camera_image_size: set the Camera image width and height while adjusting FoV to maintain aspect ratio
reset_camera_extrinsic: reset the Camera extrinsic parameters by updating rotation and translation matrices
create_minicam_instance: create a MiniCam lightweight camera object with precomputed world view and projection transforms
export_camera_to_json: export a Camera object to a JSON-serializable dictionary with position, rotation, and focal length
